manual.behavior: API v10 GET /invites/{invite.code}; exact descriptor InviteEndpoints.get. Success requires HTTP 200 with the typed documented response; missing or malformed bodies fail. Invite GET is anonymous by default with explicit bot authentication and optional count/event plus preview channel/message query fields. Delete requires MANAGE_CHANNELS on its channel or MANAGE_GUILD and accepts the audit reason header. Target reads require inviter, MANAGE_GUILD or VIEW_AUDIT_LOG; target mutations require inviter or MANAGE_GUILD. CSV export requires the exact user_id header, preserves ordered duplicate IDs and exact bytes under finite caller-selected byte/row caps; nondefault decoder bounds disable reuse. CSV replacement sends one bounded multipart file, and HTTP 204 acknowledges upload only. Bulk mutations enforce 1-1000 IDs without inventing partial results. Job status explicitly disables read reuse; successful target mutations invalidate scoped invite/channel/guild/audit reads. Opaque codes do not create new major-rate partitions. Shared credential-scoped admission, finite rejected-429 retries, cancellation and body cleanup are inherited. Eligible reads use safe scope-isolated coalescing with opt-in positive completed TTLs; mutations are unsafe and do not replay ambiguous submissions. No implicit hydration or generic batching occurs.
